name: Market at Cross Creek Ranch
summary: Market at Cross Creek Ranch is a community shopping center serving the rapidly growing Fulshear area in west Houston. Managed by Phillips Edison & Company, the center provides convenient retail, dining, and services to the affluent Cross Creek Ranch master-planned community and surrounding neighborhoods.
demographics: Market at Cross Creek Ranch serves the affluent and rapidly growing Fulshear community in west Houston, attracting primarily upper-middle-class families with children and young professionals. The trade area consists of newer master-planned communities with households earning above-average incomes, drawn to the area's highly-rated schools and suburban lifestyle. Shoppers in this market prioritize convenience and quality, seeking everyday necessities alongside specialty retail and dining options close to home. The center benefits from strong population growth in the Cross Creek Ranch development and surrounding Fulshear area, with residents who value community-oriented shopping experiences.
description: Market at Cross Creek Ranch is a modern community shopping center strategically located in the heart of one of Houston's fastest-growing master-planned communities in Fulshear, Texas. Situated at 27120 Fulshear Bend Drive, this center serves as a vital retail hub for the thriving Cross Creek Ranch development and surrounding neighborhoods in west Houston. The property is owned and managed by Phillips Edison & Company, a leading retail real estate investment trust specializing in well-located grocery-anchored shopping centers. Market at Cross Creek Ranch offers residents convenient access to essential services, dining, and retail options within their own community, reducing the need to travel into central Houston for everyday needs. The center's strategic location in the rapidly expanding Fulshear area positions it to benefit from continued residential growth and increasing household incomes in this desirable suburban market.
